The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''32,925 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''3,528 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. [[Je'daii Master|Master]] [[Deela jan Morolla]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] was alive at that [[Time/Legends|time]], and he was recorded reminding his fellow Je'daii that their true home was [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], not [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
